cohort: Primiparous singleton pregnancies delivered at ≥22 weeks of gestation at Japanese Red Cross Katsushika Maternity Hospital between 2003-2007 and 2013-2017
finding: The percentage of AMA pregnancies increased, with a decrease in cesarean delivery and an increase in postpartum hemorrhage, associated with the increased use of IVF.
mod_finding: While the percentage of cesarean deliveries decreased among advanced maternal age (AMA) pregnancies, the prevalence of postpartum hemorrhage increased, potentially linked to the rise in in vitro fertilization (IVF).
